notes: Owner 2026-10-04: use 70-80% of the week's allowance; daytime (before 17:00 UK) stays light because the owner uses Claude at work; after 17:00 UK each 5-hour session may be run to its limit. The owner reports usage with a Telegram note like `usage 62% fable 71%`; any routine that reads it updates `report` here. The weekly allowance resets Thursday 03:00 UTC. `npm run slots` (2026-10-14, foundry slot-utilisation-report) asks for a fresh note through the Monday report's digest line when `report.date` is older than 7 days, once per 7 days. While `report.date` is older than 7 days the burn-down paces itself (2026-10-24, foundry burn-pace-stale-usage-report): Monday and Tuesday nights stop after three slots that found work, and any night stops on a usage-limit signal of the last 24 h (`npm run pipeline cold` prints `paced: …`).
